links.title: A visa to visit Finland - Ministry for Foreign Affairs
Visa requirement and travel documents accepted by Finland - Ministry for Foreign Affairs

docs.text: Visa application form completed and signed
One colour photograph
Passport valid at least 3 months after the intended travel, issued within the last 10 years
Travel insurance valid for the whole Schengen area, minimum coverage EUR 30,000
Supporting documents showing purpose, conditions and duration of visit (tickets, hotel confirmation, invitation)
Proof of sufficient financial means (minimum EUR 50 per day in Finland)
Parental consent for unaccompanied minors
Application submitted in person with biometric identifiers (fingerprints)

links.title: A visa to visit Finland - Ministry for Foreign Affairs

docs.text: Free-form invitation letter with host and visitor details, purpose and length of visit
Proof of sponsorship form (notarised) if the host pays for the trip
Copy of host's identity card and residence permit (if host is not a Finnish citizen)
Copy of host's employment contract, last 3 months' payslips and bank statements
Proof of right of possession of the dwelling if staying with the host
Evidence of family relationship or of previous meetings with the host
Applicant's own proof of financial situation, passport, photo and travel insurance
